title: Sapu003 in Advanced mTOR-sensitive Solid Tumors

rules.rule_text: Age at least 18 years at time of informed consent
rules.source_text: Minimum age: 18 Years

rules.rule_text: Postmenopausal woman with amenorrhea for ≥ 12 consecutive months without another pathophysiological cause
rules.source_text: Cohort A (HR+/HER2- breast cancer): Eligible patients must be postmenopausal women, defined as women ≥ 18 years of age with amenorrhea for ≥ 12 consecutive months without another pathophysiological cause.

rules.rule_text: Both male and female adults with advanced disease
rules.source_text: Cohort B (RCC, NETs, TSC-associated tumors, HCC): Eligible patients include both male and female adults with advanced disease.
rules.applies_if: Cohort B (RCC, NETs, TSC-associated tumors, HCC)

rules.rule_text: Histologically or cytologically documented advanced (metastatic or unresectable) hormone receptor-positive, HER2 negative breast cancer
rules.source_text: Has histologically or cytologically documented advanced (metastatic or unresectable) hormone receptor-positive, HER2 negative breast cancer (advanced HR+ BC)

rules.rule_text: Stage IV or locally advanced breast cancer per AJCC Cancer Staging Manual, Seventh Edition
rules.source_text: Has stage IV or locally advanced breast cancer per the American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) Cancer Staging Manual, Seventh Edition;

rules.rule_text: Failed any combination endocrine therapy or relapsed within 6 months of adjuvant chemotherapy for metastatic or locally advanced disease, with prior therapy including non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor unless clinically contraindicated
rules.source_text: Has failed any combination endocrine therapy or relapse within 6 months of adjuvant chemotherapy for metastatic or locally advanced disease. Prior therapy should have included a non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor unless clinically contraindicated;

rules.rule_text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced (metastatic or unresectable) disease in RCC, NETs, TSC-associated tumors, or HCC
rules.source_text: Has histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced (metastatic or unresectable) disease in one of the following tumor types: Renal Cell Carcinoma (RCC), Neuroendocrine Tumors (NETs), Tuberous Sclerosis Complex (TSC)-associated tumors, Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC)

rules.rule_text: Disease is measurable and/or evaluable per RECIST v1.1 or relevant criteria
rules.source_text: Has disease that is measurable and/or evaluable per RECIST v1.1 (or relevant criteria, if applicable).

rules.rule_text: Progressed on or intolerant to at least one prior line of standard therapy appropriate for tumor type, unless no effective standard therapy exists
rules.source_text: Has progressed on or is intolerant to at least one prior line of standard therapy appropriate for the specific tumor type, unless no effective standard therapy exists.

rules.rule_text: Agreed to participate in the study and signed the informed consent form prior to participation in any study activities
rules.source_text: Has agreed to participate in the study and signed the informed consent form prior to participation in any study activities.

rules.rule_text: On stable doses of metformin or statin
rules.source_text: Patients must be on stable doses of metformin or statin

rules.rule_text: ECOG performance status ≤ 2
rules.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≤ 2.

rules.rule_text: Life expectancy ≥ 3 months
rules.source_text: Life expectancy ≥ 3 months

rules.rule_text: Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) ≥ 2,000 cells/mm3 (2 x10^9/L)
rules.source_text: Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) ≥ 2,000 cells/mm3 (2 x109/L)
rules.notes: Lab value obtained within 7 days prior to randomization

rules.rule_text: Platelet count ≥ 100,000 cells/mm3 (100x10^9/L)
rules.source_text: Platelet count ≥ 100,000 cells/mm3 (100x109/L)
rules.notes: Lab value obtained within 7 days prior to randomization

rules.rule_text: Hemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL
rules.source_text: Hemoglobin≥ 9 g/dL
rules.notes: Lab value obtained within 7 days prior to randomization

rules.rule_text: Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 x the upper limit of normal (ULN)
rules.source_text: Serum creatinine≤ 1.5 x the upper limit of normal (ULN)
rules.notes: Lab value obtained within 7 days prior to randomization

rules.rule_text: Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 x ULN or direct bilirubin ≤ 1 x ULN for patients with total bilirubin levels > 1.5 ULN
rules.source_text: Total bilirubin ≤1.5 x ULN or direct bilirubin ≤1 x ULN for patients with total bilirubin levels > 1.5 ULN
rules.notes: Lab value obtained within 7 days prior to randomization

rules.rule_text: AST (SGOT) / ALT (SGPT) ≤ 2.5 x ULN (≤ 5 x ULN for patients with metastases)
rules.source_text: AST (SGOT) / ALT (SGPT) ≤ 2.5 x ULN (≤5 x ULN for patients with metastases.)
rules.notes: Lab value obtained within 7 days prior to randomization

rules.rule_text: GFR ≥ 50 mL/min/1.73m2 by the CKD-EPI or MDRD formulas
rules.source_text: GFR ≥ 50 mL/min/1.73m2 by the CKD-EPI or MDRD formulas.
rules.notes: Lab value obtained within 7 days prior to randomization

rules.rule_text: All other clinical laboratory values deemed as normal or not clinically significant by the Principal Investigator/Sub-Investigator
rules.source_text: All other clinical laboratory values deemed as normal or not clinically significant by the Principal Investigator/Sub-Investigator.

rules.rule_text: Non-lactating (breastfeeding must be discontinued prior to first dose of study drug)
rules.source_text: Breastfeeding: Patients must be non-lactating. Because there is an unknown but potential risk for adverse events in nursing infants secondary to treatment of the mother, breastfeeding must be discontinued prior to the first dose of study drug.

rules.rule_text: Female patients of reproductive potential must avoid becoming pregnant and use effective contraception during study and for 8 weeks after last dose
rules.source_text: Female patients of reproductive potential to avoid becoming pregnant and to use effective contraception during the study and for 8 weeks after the last dose.

rules.rule_text: Male patients with female partners of reproductive potential must use effective contraception during study and for 4 weeks after last dose
rules.source_text: Male patients with female partners of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during the study and for 4 weeks after the last dose.

rules.rule_text: Able and willing to adhere to all protocol requirements and study procedures throughout the course of the study
rules.source_text: Able and willing to adhere to all protocol requirements and study procedures throughout the course of the study.

rules.rule_text: Able to comprehend and be informed of the nature of the study, as assessed by study clinic staff
rules.source_text: Ability to comprehend and be informed of the nature of the study, as assessed by study clinic staff

rules.rule_text: History of other malignancies except adequately treated non-melanoma skin cancer, curatively treated in-situ carcinoma of cervix, curatively treated in-situ carcinoma of breast, or other solid tumors curatively treated with no evidence of disease for > 5 years
rules.source_text: Patients with a history of other malignancies, except for adequately treated non-melanoma skin cancer, curatively treated in-situ carcinoma of the cervix, curatively treated in-situ carcinoma of the breast, or other solid tumors curatively treated with no evidence of disease for > 5 years.

rules.rule_text: Has not completely recovered from toxicities from previous chemotherapy, hormone therapy, immunotherapy, target therapy, or radiotherapies (Grade ≥ 1 per NCI CTCAE version 5.0, with exception of alopecia)
rules.source_text: Patients who have not completely recovered from any toxicities from previous chemotherapy, hormone therapy, immunotherapy, target therapy, or radiotherapies ≥ Grade 1 per NCI CTCAE version 5.0, with the exception of alopecia.

rules.rule_text: Prior chemotherapy within 30 days prior to screening
rules.source_text: Prior chemotherapy within 30 days prior to screening (42 days for mitomycin C or nitrosoureas).

rules.rule_text: Prior chemotherapy with mitomycin C or nitrosoureas within 42 days prior to screening
rules.source_text: Prior chemotherapy within 30 days prior to screening (42 days for mitomycin C or nitrosoureas).

rules.rule_text: Prior immunotherapy, prior anti-tumor hormonal therapy (for breast cancer patients), or prior radiotherapy within 30 days prior to screening
rules.source_text: Prior immunotherapy, prior anti-tumor hormonal therapy (for breast cancer patients), and prior radiotherapy within 30 days prior to screening.

rules.rule_text: Radiotherapy during study
rules.source_text: Radiotherapy is not allowed during study.

rules.rule_text: Administration of other chemotherapy, immunotherapy, or anti-tumor hormonal therapy during the study
rules.source_text: Administration of other chemotherapy, immunotherapy, or anti-tumor hormonal therapy during the study is not allowed.

rules.rule_text: Major surgery within 30 days prior to randomization, or has not recovered from prior major surgery
rules.source_text: Patients had major surgery within 30 days prior to randomization, or patients have not recovered from prior major surgery.

rules.rule_text: Sensory / Peripheral neuropathy of Grade > 1 per NCI CTCAE version 5.0 at Screening
rules.source_text: Sensory / Peripheral neuropathy of > Grade 1 per NCI CTCAE version 5.0 at Screening.

rules.rule_text: Active brain metastases
rules.source_text: Patients with active brain metastases.

rules.rule_text: Treated brain metastases eligible if no evidence of active disease and off definitive therapy (including steroids) at least 3 months prior to randomization
rules.source_text: Patients with treated brain metastases are eligible provided they have no evidence of active brain disease and are off of definitive therapy (including steroids) at least 3 months prior to randomization.

rules.rule_text: Known history or presence of clinically significant disease or condition other than cancer (hepatic, renal/genitourinary, gastrointestinal, cardiovascular, cerebrovascular, pulmonary, endocrine, immunological, musculoskeletal, neurological, psychiatric, dermatological, or hematological) unless determined as not clinically significant by Principal Investigator/Sub-Investigator
rules.source_text: Known history or presence of any clinically significant disease or condition other than cancer unless determined as not clinically significant by the Principal Investigator/Sub-Investigator. This includes, but is not limited to, the following: hepatic, renal/genitourinary, gastrointestinal (e.g., intra-abdominal inflammation), cardiovascular (e.g., congestive heart failure, ventricular arrhythmia, myocardial infarction, unstable angina pectoris), cerebrovascular, pulmonary (e.g., interstitial lung disease), endocrine, immunological, musculoskeletal, neurological, psychiatric, dermatological, or hematological (e.g., bleeding diathesis or coagulopathy).

rules.rule_text: History of difficulty with donating blood or difficulty in accessibility of central line
rules.source_text: History of difficulty with donating blood or difficulty in accessibility of central line.

rules.rule_text: Known history or presence of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV)
rules.source_text: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV), Hepatitis B, or Hepatitis C (serology to confirm absence is required within 7 days prior to randomization and assessed based on local labs);

rules.rule_text: Known history or presence of Hepatitis B
rules.source_text: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV), Hepatitis B, or Hepatitis C (serology to confirm absence is required within 7 days prior to randomization and assessed based on local labs);

rules.rule_text: Known history or presence of Hepatitis C
rules.source_text: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV), Hepatitis B, or Hepatitis C (serology to confirm absence is required within 7 days prior to randomization and assessed based on local labs);

rules.rule_text: Alcohol abuse or dependence within one year prior to randomization
rules.source_text: Alcohol abuse or dependence within one year prior to randomization;

rules.rule_text: Drug abuse or dependence (marijuana, amphetamines, barbiturates, cocaine, opiates and benzodiazepines)
rules.source_text: Drug abuse or dependence (marijuana, amphetamines, barbiturates, cocaine, opiates and benzodiazepines);

rules.rule_text: Hypersensitivity or idiosyncratic reaction to everolimus, other rapamycin derivatives or its excipients
rules.source_text: Hypersensitivity or idiosyncratic reaction to everolimus, other rapamycin derivatives or its excipients

rules.rule_text: Severe allergic reactions (e.g., anaphylactic reactions, angioedema)
rules.source_text: Severe allergic reactions (e.g., anaphylactic reactions, angioedema).

rules.rule_text: Participation in any other clinical protocol or investigational trial with experimental therapy or investigational devices with therapeutic intent within 30 days prior to randomization and while enrolled in this study
rules.source_text: Patients may not participate in any other clinical protocol or investigational trial that involves administration of experimental therapy and/or the use of investigational devices with therapeutic intent within 30 days prior to randomization and while enrolled in this study.

rules.rule_text: Use of strong inhibitors of cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes (e.g., fluoxetine, quinidine, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin, fluconazole, ketoconazole, diltiazem and HIV antivirals) in the previous 14 days before randomization until the last blood draw
rules.source_text: Use of any strong inhibitors of cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes (e.g., fluoxetine, quinidine, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin, fluconazole, ketoconazole, diltiazem and HIV antivirals) and strong inducers of CYP enzymes (e.g., barbiturates (phenobarbital), carbamazepine, phenytoin and rifampin), in the previous 14 days before randomization until the last blood draw in the study.

rules.rule_text: Use of strong inducers of CYP enzymes (e.g., barbiturates (phenobarbital), carbamazepine, phenytoin and rifampin) in the previous 14 days before randomization until the last blood draw
rules.source_text: Use of any strong inhibitors of cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes (e.g., fluoxetine, quinidine, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin, fluconazole, ketoconazole, diltiazem and HIV antivirals) and strong inducers of CYP enzymes (e.g., barbiturates (phenobarbital), carbamazepine, phenytoin and rifampin), in the previous 14 days before randomization until the last blood draw in the study.

rules.rule_text: Acute active infection requiring antibiotics, antiviral agents, or antifungal agents within 14 days prior to randomization
rules.source_text: Acute active infection requiring antibiotics, antiviral agents, or antifungal agents within 14 days prior to randomization

rules.rule_text: Pregnant women
rules.source_text: Pregnant or lactating women.

rules.rule_text: Lactating women
rules.source_text: Pregnant or lactating women.
